name: process-draft
about: A draft for a process pack: the types and the grid of a flat part that a shop cuts from sheet or plate by laser, plasma or water jet and may then bend on a press brake. It is written by hand from the design guidelines that shops and makers of machines publish, and from a list of the stages of making a part. Each line names one publisher that raises it, with the page's address and the day it was fetched in the anchor's standard. Other publishers give other numbers for most lines. It has no rows and no rules, so every line that can arise is open. It is a task for two transcribers and is in no deck that ships.

types.what: a flat part cut from sheet or plate by one process at one shop. Its cut features are stated by bounds: each bound says that no feature of the part is past it, and a part with no such feature may state any value

fields.name: shop
fields.what: whose published limits the part is checked against: a named shop, or maker for the guidance of the makers of the machines where no shop is named, or strictest for the strictest limit the deck holds, which is no shop's own rule

fields.name: process
fields.what: how it is cut: by fiber or CO2 laser, by plasma arc, or by abrasive water jet

fields.name: material
fields.what: the family of its metal, as the shops' tables name one

fields.name: thickness
fields.what: the nominal thickness of its stock

fields.name: length
fields.what: the longer side of the smallest rectangle that holds its outline

fields.name: width
fields.what: the shorter side of that rectangle

fields.name: hole
fields.what: a diameter that no round cut of the part is under

fields.name: slot
fields.what: a width that no slot, notch or other cut that is not round is under

fields.name: web
fields.what: a width of metal that is left between any two cuts

fields.name: margin
fields.what: a width of metal that is left between any cut and the outline

fields.name: tab
fields.what: a width that no tab, finger or other narrow run of the outline is under

fields.name: corner
fields.what: a radius that no inside corner of the outline or of a cut is under

fields.name: inner
fields.what: whether any cut lies inside the outline, and so starts from a pierce through the stock

fields.name: edges
fields.what: whether the need takes the edges as the cut leaves them or asks for them deburred

fields.name: finish
fields.what: the coating the shop puts on it after cutting

fields.name: tolerance
fields.what: the tightest tolerance, plus or minus, that the need puts on a cut dimension

fields.name: lean
fields.what: the most that a cut edge may lean from square over the thickness, as the need allows

fields.name: heat
fields.what: the greatest depth of heat-affected metal at a cut edge that the need allows

fields.name: flatness
fields.what: the greatest bow from flat over the part's length that the need allows

types.what: every bend of a part on a press brake, which are alike in angle and inside radius. Its lengths are bounds over those bends, as a cut_part states its cuts

fields.name: angle
fields.what: the angle each flange is turned through, in degrees: 90 for a square corner

fields.name: radius
fields.what: the inside radius of each bend

fields.name: allowance
fields.what: the length of flat stock the part gives each bend, between the two lines where the bend begins and ends

fields.name: flange
fields.what: a length that no leg is under, from a bend line to the nearest cut edge, on the flat part

fields.name: length
fields.what: a length that no bend line is over

fields.name: clear
fields.what: a distance from a bend line that no hole, slot or other cut that the line does not cross is within

fields.name: between
fields.what: a distance that no two bend lines are nearer than

fields.name: stop
fields.what: a length that the straight edge parallel to each bend line, which the back gauge meets, is not under

fields.name: relief_width
fields.what: a width that no relief cut at the end of a bend line is under

fields.name: relief_depth
fields.what: a depth, from the bend line, that no relief cut at the end of a bend line is under

fields.name: grain
fields.what: how the bend lines lie to the rolling direction of the stock: across it, along it, or not stated to the shop

fields.name: angle_tolerance
fields.what: the tightest tolerance, plus or minus and in degrees, that the need puts on the angle

fields.name: tolerance
fields.what: the tightest tolerance, plus or minus, that the need puts on a distance from a bend to an edge or to another bend

types.what: a flat part that the shop that cut it then bends on a press brake, by air bending, with every bend alike

fields.name: count
fields.what: the number of its bends

fields.name: flat
fields.what: the flat part before bending

fields.name: bends
fields.what: its bends
